calls.statement:
WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS orders,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) AS gross, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS test_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=wd.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND wd.dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-29' AND DATE '2024-10-27'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, order_total_gross, line_count, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
l AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id, f.gross_amount, f.net_amount, f.vat_rate, f.quantity, s.store_id, f.channel_code, f.etl_loaded_at
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM wd WHERE dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-29' AND DATE '2024-10-27')
)
SELECT 'dup receipt+line' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS v FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM l GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines non-900', COUNT(*) FROM l WHERE store_id<>900
UNION ALL SELECT 'gross vs net*(1+vat) off >0.02', COUNT(*) FROM l WHERE abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02
UNION ALL SELECT 'orders in window', COUNT(*) FROM wd WHERE dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-29' AND DATE '2024-10-27'
UNION ALL SELECT 'orders in window without lines', COUNT(*) FROM wd WHERE dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-29' AND DATE '2024-10-27' AND web_order_id NOT IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM l)
UNION ALL SELECT 'orders where line gross sum != order_total (>0.05)', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT w.web_order_id FROM wd w JOIN l ON l.receipt_id=w.web_order_id WHERE w.dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-29' AND DATE '2024-10-27' GROUP BY w.web_order_id, w.order_total_gross HAVING abs(SUM(l.gross_amount)-w.order_total_gross)>0.05)
UNION ALL SELECT 'null gross', COUNT(*) FROM l WHERE gross_amount IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg qty/gross', COUNT(*) FROM l WHERE gross_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0

SELECT o.status, (o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL) AS no_dispatch, o.order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01' AND o.order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2024-11-15' AS near, COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS orders_with_lines, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS gross_lines

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wd.dispatch_date) AS days_with_sales, MIN(wd.dispatch_date) AS first_day, MAX(wd.dispatch_date) AS last_day,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.sale_date<>wd.dispatch_date THEN f.sales_line_id END) AS lines_dispatch_ne_saledate,
 MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_load
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE wd.dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-29' AND DATE '2024-10-27'

calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS web_sales_incl_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2
